"Список" matches the supplied game glossary, and the quoted control name exactly matches current ru shell.discard. dismissHero removes the hero from in-memory roster data and marks files dirty; discardAllChanges restores snapshots, while successful Save replaces those snapshots. If Steam remains running, old file sizes will be retained and the game will become unable to load the campaign. Overwrite-only restoration and ordinary saving are unaffected.

safetyVerdict.workflow: Dialog.Description displays this key. Confirm invokes handleDiscard, which runs discardAllChanges: JSON.parse restores the existing snapshots and clears dirtyFiles. loadRoster and sibling loaders establish snapshots. Separately, Save awaits save_profile and its transactional writes, then invokes clearAllDirty to replace the baseline. Discard performs no load_profile call.

The blind English matches the current source and code. No residual P1/P2 or P3 suggestion. Blind backtranslation was persisted before source access. The verdict below is derived from the persisted blind translation and inspected implementation, but the review is not wholly unexposed to earlier evidence. Parent must assess eligibility and verify actual reviewer identity before approving.

discard.description.semanticEvidence: Evaluated against CURRENT English "restore the last loaded or saved state", not any earlier disk-state association. 未保存の変更をすべて preserves the complete unsaved-edit scope; 直近の読み込み時または保存時の状態 identifies the loaded/saved snapshot without promising a fresh disk read. この操作は取り消せません correctly warns that Discard itself has no undo. loadRoster/loadEstate/loadTown/loadUpgrades establish snapshots (save-data.svelte.ts:776-796); clearAllDirty refreshes them after a successful save (:908), and discardAllChanges parses them and clears dirty state without I/O (:925). Source/target contain no ICU arguments, plural/select branches, exact counts, pound substitutions, or rich tags, consistent with slots:[]. Target is 50 code points versus 111 in English. store.reviveDeadOnly.semanticEvidence: Both dead status and roster membership limit revival eligibility.

store.reviveHpUnknown.semanticEvidence: Unknown class maximum HP explicitly prevents revival.

store.revertTrinkets.sourceText: Use Discard All to restore trinket edits and estate inventory together.
store.revertTrinkets.translationText: 「すべての変更を破棄」でトリンケットの編集と領地のアイテムリストをまとめて元に戻してください。

safetyVerdict.action: Require global Discard for a consistent trinket revert.
safetyVerdict.object: hero trinket edits together with estate inventory
safetyVerdict.conditions: Current trinkets differ from that hero in rosterSnapshot.
safetyVerdict.reversibility: Individual reset is refused; global Discard loses all unsaved edits, including both related inventories.
safetyVerdict.scope: Refusal prevents a one-file in-memory reset; global Discard restores roster and estate snapshots without writing disk.
safetyVerdict.workflow: Reset reports this message rather than duplicating or losing equipment by restoring only a hero.
safetyVerdict.backTranslation: Use Discard all changes to revert trinket edits and the estate item list together.
safetyVerdict.note: すべての変更を破棄 names the actual full-discard action and まとめて preserves coupled restoration.

store.revertTrinkets.semanticEvidence: Directs Discard All to revert hero trinkets and estate inventory together.

safetyVerdict.action: Execute global discard after confirmation.
safetyVerdict.object: all unsaved loaded-profile edits
safetyVerdict.conditions: User clicks final destructive button; handleDiscard refuses while saving.
safetyVerdict.reversibility: Unsaved edits are lost with no redo facility; disk contents are preserved.
safetyVerdict.scope: Restores all loaded in-memory snapshots, not a fresh disk read.
safetyVerdict.workflow: Final button invokes handleDiscard then discardAllChanges and a completion toast.
safetyVerdict.backTranslation: Discard all changes
safetyVerdict.note: すべて retains all changes rather than just the visible tab or hero.

hero.safety.dismissDead.sourceText: Dead heroes cannot be dismissed. Their roster record preserves the grave.
hero.safety.dismissDead.translationText: 死亡したヒーローは解雇できません。墓を維持するため、メンバーリストの記録を残す必要があります。

safetyVerdict.action: Refuse dismissal and retain the grave record.
safetyVerdict.object: the selected dead hero and grave record
safetyVerdict.conditions: roster.status is 3; dead heroes must NOT be removed from the roster.

safetyVerdict.scope: Refusal protects in-memory the selected dead hero and grave record; neither roster deletion nor a disk write occurs.
safetyVerdict.workflow: Hero detail computes dismissReason; the action is disabled and dismissHero rechecks the same guard before mutation.
safetyVerdict.backTranslation: Dead heroes cannot be dismissed. Their member-list records must be retained to preserve their graves.
safetyVerdict.note: 死亡した and できません preserve the dead-only refusal; 墓 and 記録 preserve the reason for retaining the entry.

hero.safety.dismissDead.semanticEvidence: Dead-hero dismissal is refused to preserve the grave record.

hero.safety.dismissLastHero.sourceText: You need at least 1 hero to venture on. Recruit another hero before dismissing this one.
hero.safety.dismissLastHero.translationText: 探索を続けるには少なくとも1人のヒーローが必要です。このヒーローを解雇する前に、別のヒーローを雇用してください。

safetyVerdict.scope: Refusal protects in-memory the last living roster hero; neither roster deletion nor a disk write occurs.

hero.safety.dismissLastHero.semanticEvidence: At least one hero must remain; recruit another before dismissal.

hero.safety.dismissTreatment.sourceText: Release this hero from treatment before dismissing them.
hero.safety.dismissTreatment.translationText: 解雇する前に、このヒーローの治療を終了してください。

safetyVerdict.workflow: Hero detail computes dismissReason; the action is disabled and dismissHero rechecks the same guard before mutation.
safetyVerdict.backTranslation: End this hero’s treatment before dismissing them.

hero.safety.dismissTreatment.semanticEvidence: Treatment must end before dismissing this hero.

hero.safety.dismissParty.sourceText: This hero is in the raid party. Return to town before dismissing them.

hero.safety.dismissParty.semanticEvidence: Active-party membership requires returning to town before dismissal.

hero.safety.dismissRaid.semanticEvidence: Dismissal is unavailable throughout an active expedition.

hero.safety.reviveCapacity.sourceText: Revival is blocked because roster capacity is unknown. Load the installed Stage Coach capacity data and complete upgrade data.

safetyVerdict.action: Discard all unsaved edits and restore the last loaded or successfully saved state.
safetyVerdict.object: The active profile data held in the editor: roster, estate, town, upgrades, raid, game, campaign log and progression snapshots.
safetyVerdict.conditions: The Discard dialog is requested only when dirty and not saving. Confirmation calls handleDiscard, which also refuses while saving. The state is the last load or successful Save snapshot, not freshly read disk data.
safetyVerdict.reversibility: The discarded unsaved edits have no undo buffer. discardAllChanges replaces live values from snapshots and clears dirty flags; it does not preserve the discarded versions.
safetyVerdict.scope: All unsaved loaded profile edits, not only the current hero or pane. Discard performs no IPC and neither rereads nor writes disk.
safetyVerdict.workflow: DiscardConfirmDialog description accompanies the destructive confirm button -> layout handleDiscard -> discardAllChanges parses each saved JSON snapshot and clears dirtyFiles. loadRoster/loadEstate/etc establish snapshots; successful createSaveWorkflow write -> saved -> clearAllDirty refreshes them. No loadProfile or saveProfile call occurs on Discard.
safetyVerdict.note: The blind English matches current source action, all-unsaved scope, loaded-or-saved baseline and no-undo warning. "último estado carregado ou salvo" does not promise disk reload. Blind file was persisted before any source access. A later overbroad rg search returned prior pilot-status.json evidence excerpts and other locale strings. This accidental post-blind exposure is disclosed in the report; verdict reasoning was checked directly against current code. Parent must decide acceptance and verify reviewer identity.
safetyVerdict.backTranslation: This will discard all unsaved changes and restore the last loaded or saved state. This action cannot be undone.

discard.description.sourceText: This will discard all unsaved changes and restore the last loaded or saved state. This action cannot be undone.
discard.description.translationText: Tímto zahodíte všechny neuložené změny a vrátíte data do stavu při posledním načtení nebo uložení. Tuto akci nelze vrátit zpět.

safetyVerdict.action: Discard all unsaved edits and restore the last loaded or successfully saved snapshots.
safetyVerdict.object: All loaded save-data domains in the active profile, not just the selected hero.
safetyVerdict.conditions: Shown after the dirty-state Discard action; confirmation invokes handleDiscard unless a save is in progress. Snapshot baseline is established on load and refreshed after successful Save.
safetyVerdict.reversibility: Discard replaces edited memory with snapshots and clears dirty flags; it retains no redo copy of discarded edits. Czech explicitly states this action cannot be undone.
safetyVerdict.scope: Profile-wide in-memory restoration of roster, estate, town, upgrades, raid, game, campaign log and progression. No disk reread or write occurs in discardAllChanges.
safetyVerdict.workflow: Toolbar Zahodit opens the confirmation; Zahodit všechny změny calls handleDiscard and discardAllChanges. JSON.parse of each snapshot restores memory and dirtyFiles becomes empty. load functions capture snapshots; successful save calls clearAllDirty after the awaited write. Discard has no IPC call.
safetyVerdict.note: Blind translation matches the current English action, all-unsaved scope, latest load/save baseline and negation. Czech posledním načtení nebo uložení does not promise to reload external disk edits. No residual P1/P2 or P3 identified. Procedure disclosure: blind JSON was persisted before any source access. A subsequent overly broad rg search accidentally displayed prior-review excerpts from src/lib/i18n/pilot-status.json (including other locales). This assessment was made from the current strings and directly inspected code, but prior-record exposure must not be concealed or treated as a pristine source-only review.
safetyVerdict.backTranslation: This will discard all unsaved changes and return the data to the state at the last load or save. This action cannot be undone.

previous.sourceText: This will revert all unsaved changes and reload data from disk. This action cannot be undone.
previous.translationText: Tímto vrátíte všechny neuložené změny a znovu načtete data z disku. Tuto akci nelze vrátit zpět.
previous.semanticEvidence: Retains reversion of unsaved edits, reload from disk and inability to undo.

discard.description.semanticEvidence: The CURRENT English restores the last loaded or saved state, not a fresh disk read. Czech "všechny neuložené změny" preserves the full loss scope, "do stavu při posledním načtení nebo uložení" preserves the snapshot boundary, and "Tuto akci nelze vrátit zpět" correctly makes Discard itself irreversible. loadRoster/loadEstate/etc. capture snapshots, clearAllDirty refreshes them after a successful save, and discardAllChanges parses those snapshots without disk I/O (save-data.svelte.ts:775,907,925; +layout.svelte:438,440,507). Neutral formal Czech agrees with the editor register. Plain text: neither string has ICU slots, exact-count/plural branches, or rich tags; CLDR agreement is inapplicable. 127 Czech versus 111 English characters is reasonable in the wrapping max-w-md dialog (DiscardConfirmDialog.svelte:19,25).

error.steam_restore_blocked.sourceText: Quit Steam completely before restoring this backup. It adds or removes save files, and the running Steam client would keep stale file sizes, which stops the game from loading the campaign. Overwrite-only restores and normal saves are not affected.

La restauración añade o elimina archivos de partida y, si Steam sigue abierto, conservaría tamaños de archivo desactualizados que impedirían al juego cargar la campaña. Esto no afecta a las restauraciones que solo sobrescriben archivos ni al guardado normal.

safetyVerdict.scope: Protects disk file-set changes and Steam file-size cache, not memory-only hero edits.
safetyVerdict.workflow: Preflight exposes blocked reason; final apply also refuses; UI offers recheck.
safetyVerdict.backTranslation: Close Steam completely before restoring this copy. Restoration adds or deletes save files and, if Steam remains open, it would retain outdated file sizes that would prevent the game from loading the campaign. This does not affect restorations that only overwrite files or normal saving.
safetyVerdict.note: Por completo, añade o elimina, stale file-size cause and both exceptions are retained exactly in meaning.
safetyVerdict.originalBackTranslation: Close Steam completely before restoring this copy. Restoration adds or deletes save files and, if Steam remains open, it would retain outdated file sizes that would prevent the game from loading the campaign. This does not affect restorations that only overwrite files or normal saving.

safetyVerdict.object: The active profile data held in the save-data store, including roster, estate, town, upgrades, raid, game, campaign log and progression snapshots.
safetyVerdict.conditions: The shell opens this confirmation only when dirty and not saving; confirming calls handleDiscard, which also refuses while saving. Loaded snapshots are captured at load and refreshed after successful Save.
safetyVerdict.reversibility: Discard overwrites current in-memory data with the snapshots and clears dirty flags. It retains no undo copy of the discarded edits; it neither reloads disk nor writes disk.
safetyVerdict.scope: All unsaved loaded-profile changes, not only the selected hero. Spanish todos los cambios sin guardar and el último estado cargado o guardado preserve this scope and baseline.
safetyVerdict.workflow: Shell Discard -> requestDiscard -> DiscardConfirmDialog -> handleDiscard -> discardAllChanges -> parse saved JSON snapshots and clear dirty flags. Load functions create snapshots; successful save_profile IPC -> saved callback -> clearAllDirty refreshes them. Discard itself makes no IPC call.
safetyVerdict.note: PASS: blind translation preserves all unsaved changes, loaded-or-saved baseline, and no undo. The source and current Spanish agree with the directly inspected snapshot behavior. No ICU arguments or slots. Procedure qualification: after persisting the blind translations, an overbroad rg search accidentally returned prior pilot-status.json evidence snippets and other locales. No prior evidence was read before the blind file; this judgment was made from directly inspected current code. Parent must assess this disclosed exposure and verify reviewer identity before approval.

discard.description.semanticEvidence: The current source promises restoration of the last loaded or saved state, not a fresh disk read. «Todos los cambios sin guardar», «el último estado cargado o guardado» and «no se puede deshacer» preserve all three safety facts. discardAllChanges() restores JSON snapshots; clearAllDirty() refreshes them after successful saving. Neutral, fluent Spanish, consistent with DESCARTAR in the supplied glossary. 131 characters versus 111 English; the dialog description wraps and its container scrolls. Neither string has ICU arguments, plural/select branches, exact counts or rich tags.

safetyVerdict.object: All unsaved changes to loaded save data, including roster, estate, town, upgrades, raid, game, campaign log and progression; not only the selected hero.
safetyVerdict.conditions: Shown by requestDiscard when dirty and not saving; handleDiscard refuses while saving. The reference state is the last load or successful Save, not newly changed disk contents. French retains non sauvegardees and charge ou sauvegarde without claiming a disk reload.
safetyVerdict.reversibility: Discard overwrites current in-memory objects from stored JSON snapshots and clears dirtyFiles. There is no retained copy of the discarded edits in this path and no Discard undo; irreversible accurately describes that operation.
safetyVerdict.scope: Every loaded profile save-data snapshot; no settings reset, profile deletion, IPC invocation or disk write is performed by discardAllChanges.
safetyVerdict.workflow: Shell Discard opens DiscardConfirmDialog; its description is this key; destructive confirmation calls handleDiscard then discardAllChanges, which parses each existing snapshot and clears dirty flags without loadProfile. Snapshots originate in load functions and clearAllDirty after a successful saveProfile call.
safetyVerdict.note: Blind translation preserves all, unsaved, last loaded or saved, and no undo. No residual P1/P2. The distinction between snapshot restoration and fresh disk reload is accurate. Review independently derived from inspected code; post-blind accidental prior-evidence exposure is disclosed in the Markdown report.
safetyVerdict.backTranslation: This operation will undo all unsaved changes and restore the last loaded or saved state. This action is irreversible.

safetyVerdict.action: Summarize overwrite-only restoration or explicit file additions and/or deletions from the backend preflight counts.
safetyVerdict.object: Save-profile files: adds counts paths in the restore write map that do not currently exist, and removes counts the planned deletion paths. Korean 파일 ... 추가 and 삭제 preserve file-level additions and removals.
safetyVerdict.conditions: Four cases are preserved: adds=0/removes=0 gives existing-file overwrite only; adds=0/removes>0 gives deletions; adds>0/removes=0 gives additions; both positive gives both. The inner # always binds to removes, while addsText supplies the formatted additions.
safetyVerdict.reversibility: The summary itself is read-only. Confirmed restoration writes disk files after safety backup creation and applies a transaction with rollback on failure. In-memory Discard cannot reverse a completed disk restore; recovery uses a backup. The target makes no unsupported undo promise.
safetyVerdict.scope: The selected editor backup or the game backup for the selected save profile. Counts are filesystem path additions/deletions, not hero counts, bytes, or the total number of overwritten files. Overwrites can coexist with add/delete cases, and those branches do not claim exclusivity.
safetyVerdict.workflow: Opening either restore dialog calls check_restore and appends restoreSummary to its description. Acknowledged confirmation uses runRestore, repeats preflight around the unsaved-change decision, rejects blocked results, invokes restore_backup or restore_game_backup, and reloads the profile. Rust recomputes the plan, creates the safety backup, then applies writes/deletes transactionally. Complete manifest backups can delete displaced paths; game/legacy backups use no deletion set.
safetyVerdict.note: Pass. The blind reading recovered every branch and both file counts. Current source and target contracts match. Sixteen targeted render cases covering adds/removes 0, 1, 2 and 1000 confirm the nested # formats the removal quantity rather than duplicating addsText.
safetyVerdict.backTranslation: If adds is zero and removes is zero: This restoration only overwrites existing files. If adds is zero and removes is nonzero: This restoration deletes # files. If adds is nonzero and removes is zero: This restoration adds {addsText} files. If both are nonzero: This restoration adds {addsText} files and deletes # files.

safetyVerdict.action: Summarize whether the pending backup restore only overwrites files, adds files, deletes files, or both adds and deletes files.
safetyVerdict.object: Files in the selected profile restore plan, counted by adds and removes; addsText formats added file count and nested # formats removed file count.
safetyVerdict.conditions: Both editor-backup and game-backup dialogs append this message after read-only check_restore. Exact adds =0 and removes =0 select four outcome combinations. Restore additionally requires acknowledgement, an unblocked preflight and the unsaved-changes guard; backend validation is repeated before applying.
safetyVerdict.reversibility: The summary and check_restore do not write files. Actual restore creates a pre-restore safety backup and applies the plan transactionally, with rollback attempted on failure. The message makes no unsupported promise of an undo button or permanent deletion beyond recovery.
safetyVerdict.scope: Only files in the validated backup/profile plan. Adds count absent destination paths; removes count planned deletions. Overwrites can also occur in nonzero branches, as stated by the surrounding restore description. Game and legacy backups do not schedule complete-snapshot deletions.
safetyVerdict.workflow: check_restore prepares the plan and returns counts without applying it. restoreSummary formats addsText and renders the nested plural. Confirmation runs preflight and the unsaved guard; the restore IPC prepares a fresh plan, refuses blockers, creates a safety backup, and applies writes/deletes. The frontend reloads the profile afterward. Adds derive from destination nonexistence and removes from deletes.len().
safetyVerdict.note: Pass. The blind translation distinguished overwrite-only, deletion-only, addition-only and mixed outcomes. Chinese preserves both exact =0 tests and nested # binding to removes. All 16 pairs from adds/removes in {0,1,2,1000} rendered exactly the expected quantities and actions. No residual P1/P2/P3.
